## Scope Note
Supplied bundle has **no payroll calculation code** (no PayrollService, rate logic, BigDecimal/RoundingMode, confirmed-payroll guards, or unresolved-attendance checks). Items 1–3 cannot be verified. Findings below cover what is auditable. Note: the system prompt requires the table to be followed by a verdict line; the task prompt additionally requests a JSON array, which is placed between them.

| Finding ID | Severity | Item | Flaw Analysis | Concrete Code/Rule Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| F-01 | CRITICAL | Art.37 premium rates (OT 25%, Night 25%, Night-OT 50%, Holiday 35%, Holiday-Night 60%) | [Bundle-wide] No calculation code supplied. Compliance unverifiable; absence of evidence = unproven. Scenario: Night-OT miscalculated as 25%+25% additive with double-counted base → wrong total. | Submit PayrollCalculator/Service; require explicit rate table: OT 1.25, Night 1.25, Night-OT 1.50, Holiday 1.35, Holiday-Night 1.60 (no stacking of holiday+OT). |
| F-02 | CRITICAL | HALF_UP 50-sen rounding / BigDecimal | [Bundle-wide] No BigDecimal or RoundingMode usage visible. Scenario: double arithmetic yields ¥0.49999 errors in hourly rate. | Use `BigDecimal` with `setScale(0, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)`; apply 50-sen rule (<0.50 floor, ≥0.50 round up) per Art.37 notice, at the correct aggregation stage. |
| F-03 | CRITICAL | Confirmed-payroll overwrite guard / unresolved attendance check | [Bundle-wide] No payroll service or mod-request check supplied. Scenario: owner approves attendance modification after payroll confirmation; recalculation silently overwrites confirmed payroll. | Guard: `if (payroll.getStatus()==CONFIRMED) throw`; block confirmation while any PENDING mod-requests or missing clock-out exist. |
| F-04 | HIGH | Access control on shift confirm | [ShiftApiController.java:69-77] `confirmShift` performs no store-ownership check (unlike getEvents L39); `userDetails` unused. Scenario: owner of store A confirms shiftId from store B (IDOR). Pattern also affects payroll-adjacent shift data. | Verify shift's storeId equals `userDetails.getStoreId()` before `shiftService.confirmShift`; add `@PreAuthorize("hasRole('OWNER')")`. |
| F-05 | HIGH | Null-bypass of tenant checks | [ShiftApiController.java:39,54-61] Checks skipped when `userDetails` or its IDs are null. Scenario: null storeId bypasses the store check on requestShift/events. | Fail closed: reject when principal or IDs are null. |
| F-06 | HIGH | URL matcher gap for owner-only endpoints | [SecurityConfig.java:55 vs 65-66] `/api/shifts/*/confirm` matches only a single path segment, and the `/attendance/mod-requests/**` rule precedes `/attendance/**` correctly; however trailing-slash or `.json` variants depend on Spring 6 defaults. Scenario: PUT variant paths fall to STAFF-permitted `/api/shifts/**` if matcher misses. | Use `/api/shifts/{id}/confirm` plus `@PreAuthorize("hasRole('OWNER')")` on the method as defense in depth. |
| F-07 | MEDIUM | CSRF cookie HttpOnly=false | [SecurityConfig.java:39] XSRF cookie readable by JS; any XSS exfiltrates the token on a payroll/attendance system. | Acceptable only with strict CSP/output escaping; otherwise use a header-delivered token. |
| F-08 | MEDIUM | Session policy | [SecurityConfig.java:97-98] `maxSessionsPreventsLogin(true)` with 2 sessions: lost-device lockout blocks staff clock-in (attendance record gaps feeding wage calc). | Use `sessionRegistry` with expiry, or prevent-login false. |
| F-09 | LOW | Test coverage | [SecurityHandlerTest.java:1-72] Tests only 401/403 handlers; no authorization-matrix, tenant-isolation, or payroll tests. | Add MockMvc tests for role/store matrix and payroll rules (night-OT 1.50, holiday-night 1.60, rounding). |

VERDICT: FAIL
